nodes.title: Life Orientation
nodes.description: Life Orientation for Grade 7 covering personal wellbeing, social and environmental responsibility, democracy and human rights, recreational activities, and careers.

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Term 1: Development of the self; Constitution and Human Rights; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Development of the Self in Society
nodes.description: Personal identity and self-concept; factors that influence self-concept (family, peers, media, culture); emotional intelligence; managing emotions; self-motivation; goal setting and personal development plans. Formal Assessment Task 1: Research task on self-concept factors.

nodes.title: Democracy and Human Rights
nodes.description: The South African Constitution and Bill of Rights; rights and responsibilities of citizens; democratic values: equality, dignity, freedom; examples of human rights violations and ways to address them.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Games and Sport
nodes.description: Participation in physical activities and sports; rules and fair play; warming up and cooling down; health-related fitness: cardiovascular endurance, muscular strength and flexibility. Integrated into each week as a practical component.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Term 2: Social and Environmental Responsibility; Healthy Living; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Social and Environmental Responsibility
nodes.description: Belonging to social groups; peer pressure and peer influence; community involvement and social responsibility; environmental awareness: pollution, conservation, recycling; sustainable living practices. Formal Assessment Task 2: Project on environmental responsibility.

nodes.title: Healthy Living
nodes.description: Nutrition and balanced diet; substance abuse — alcohol, tobacco, drugs; effects on physical and mental health; making responsible choices; saying no to peer pressure around substance use.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Athletics and Movement
nodes.description: Athletics: running, jumping, throwing; movement concepts and strategies; physical fitness testing; team and individual activities promoting cooperation and healthy competition.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Term 3: Safety, Security and Violence; Careers and Career Choices; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Safety, Security and Violence Prevention
nodes.description: Types of violence: physical, emotional, sexual, cyber-bullying; consequences of violence; ways to prevent and report violence; personal safety strategies; dangerous situations and how to respond; community support structures.

nodes.title: Careers and Career Choices
nodes.description: World of work: different career fields and pathways; factors influencing career choices; interests, aptitudes and abilities; subject choices and future careers; role models in different careers. Formal Assessment Task 3: Career research presentation.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Gymnastics and Rhythmic Activities
nodes.description: Gymnastics: balancing, rolling, jumping; rhythmic activities: movement to music, dance sequences; cooperative group movement activities; body awareness and coordination.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Term 4: Study Skills and Exam Preparation; Recreational Activities; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Study Skills and Exam Preparation
nodes.description: Effective study methods; time management and study timetables; managing exam stress; test-taking strategies; mind mapping and note-taking; setting personal academic goals. Formal Assessment Task 4: Test on study skills and LO content.

nodes.title: Recreational Activities and Leisure
nodes.description: Value of recreational activities for physical and mental health; different types of leisure activities; planning and participating in recreational activities; balance between work and leisure; community recreational facilities.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Water Activities and Outdoor Education
nodes.description: Water safety and swimming (where facilities available); outdoor education activities; orienteering; environmental awareness through outdoor activities; consolidation of physical education concepts from the year.
